To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
it is possible to create ontological representations of knowledge contained in various methods of quality evaluation of Internet services.
it was possible to create a repository of knowledge on the quality of Internet websites, which was implemented in the form of domain ontologies.

(i) the proposed algorithm for building ontologies is effective in creating ontologies of the domain of quality evaluation of Internet services, (ii) the proposed algorithm is effective in the process of building ontologies of the quality evaluation of Internet sites.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an algorithm of knowledge representation and the implementation of ontologies of knowledge about the quality assessment of Internet services.
the development of the knowledge base for the quality assessment of Internet services.
the development of a knowledge repository of the methods of assessing the quality and usability of websites, which can be used in the process of designing, testing, and improving websites.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed method of building ontologies in the field of website quality assessment is effective.
the proposed approach is a good solution to the problem of building knowledge bases of quality assessment methods.
the proposed solution can be successfully used to build knowledge repositories, and the knowledge management process can be supported by the use of ontologies.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed approach can be used to create an ontology of a given subject area, which is a very useful tool for building an intelligent system.
the developed algorithms and implemented tools can be used for the construction of ontologies representing various methods of quality evaluation of the websites.
it is possible to create a system that will support the evaluation of website quality, and the quality of Internet service in general.

the proposed method can be used to build a knowledge repository in any domain.
the use of ontologies in the area of quality assessment of Internet services can be a useful tool for the development of a system supporting knowledge management.
